description: Election Commission - Declare that Mohamed Hasan Fathima Rinsa as a member of the Beruwala Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Beruwala Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of a new council member due to a vacancy caused by non-attendance. The content falls under election-related administrative matters rather than central government personnel or structural changes.
